change_log.value: Schema and contract for specialty identification inputs/outputs
Unit and edge case testing for specialty mapping

FEAT-2-S18.title: Define Specialty Identification Schema and Contracts
FEAT-2-S18.description: Define Pydantic models for specialty input (free-text query) and output (NUCC codes, classifications, confidence scores), ensuring strict validation and compatibility with tool_router and provider search inputs.

FEAT-2-S19.title: Implement Core Specialty Mapping Logic
FEAT-2-S19.description: Implement dual-pipeline specialty identification logic combining regex matching and vector similarity, including NUCC code normalization, deduplication, and classification aggregation.

FEAT-2-S20.title: Expose Specialty Identification via Facade and Tool Router
FEAT-2-S20.description: Integrate specialty identification into find_care_facade and register it as an allowlisted tool through tool_router, enabling LLM-driven invocation with validated inputs and structured outputs.

FEAT-2-S21.title: Test Specialty Identification Logic and Edge Cases
FEAT-2-S21.description: Create unit tests covering common specialties, ambiguous queries, multi-specialty inputs, and failure cases to ensure accurate NUCC mapping and stable outputs.
